links.outcome: Discrimination and calibration of PIPRA on prospective local hospital data
links.effect: AUROC=0.77 (95% CI 0.72 to 0.82); generally accurate calibration, slightly overpredicting risk in high-risk patients; POD occurred in 11.5% (n=100).
links.quote: The PIPRA model showed good discrimination (AUROC=0.77, 95% CI: 0.72 to 0.82) and generally accurate calibration, though slightly overpredicting risk in high-risk patients.

screen.reason: Prospective external validation of a CE-certified automated multivariable risk prediction model (PIPRA) for postoperative delirium in a real-world hospital cohort, evaluating discrimination and calibration.
